messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High external-tool execution rate detected in us-east-1. Queue depth rising, agent-proxy 5xx spike. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/tool-surge - severity: S2

alex: I'm paged, jumping in. Any eng-runtime oncall?

maya: maya (eng-runtime) here. Seeing sustained 3x fncall RPS vs baseline since 10s ago. Majority from thirdparty-agent traffic. KV cache pressure + tokenization slowdown.

sam: grabbing metrics. Alert shows ~45% increase in tail latency and retries spiking. Looks like retry storms from a few heavy customers.

alex: quick proposal: staged suspend of external tool/function execution for burst and free plans only, enforce text-only structured responses platform-wide to reduce serialization overhead. Aim for 15-30m window.

marta: +1 from me. Need scoped change to avoid Dedicated/reserved customers. Also add rate cap before full suspend as a gradual step.

alex: Plan of action (staged):
1) Apply global soft rate limit for toolcalls: 10 rps per region for burst/free lanes
2) If no improvement in 5m, flip scoped feature flag to disallow external exec for burst/free
3) Set response mode header enforcement -> text-only (payload-stripping) to reduce payload size
4) Notify support & prepare customer comms draft

sam: I'll implement step 1 and watch dashboards.

opsbot: action runbooks/mitigations/toolcall-staged-suspend initiated by alex

alex: Running commands now:
```
# apply soft rate limit for toolcall paths (burst/free lanes)
curl -s -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/rl -d '{"target":"toolcall","scope":"burst,free","limit_rps":10}'
# set response mode for runtime proxy
curl -s -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/response_mode -d '{"mode":"text_only","scope":"global"}'
```

opsbot: flags applied to prod-canary. Waiting verification (canary us-east-1).

maya: Canary good: queue depth down ~60% in the canary cluster, tail lat down ~35%. Some clients see truncated structured fields (expected).

alex: Good. Proceed to step 2 in 2m if metrics hold. @lina-support please standby for comms.

lina-support: lina-support here. Creating ticket INC-7592, drafting status page note: "Temporary limits applied to external tool executions to protect latency; structured output may be simplified for some responses." Will hold public post until we confirm customer list.

marta: Confirming Dedicated/reserved customers unaffected — scoping correct. I'm watching error budgets and SLOs.

support-bot: Support ticket INC-7592 created and linked to incident bridge. Assigned to support-rotation.

alex: OK holding mitigations for 20m. If stable, we'll keep soft limits for 1h and then slowly relax.

maya: Noted: a couple of high-volume customers on burst were responsible for >40% of toolcalls. Recommend follow-up rate limits per-tenant after stabilization.

alex: Agreed. @jordan you'll take the handoff in ~30m. Please prepare rollback commands: flip allow_external_exec true for burst/free and restore response_mode to structured.

jordan: Jordan: taking handoff at +30. I have the rollback cmds and will monitor for any regression. Bridge link posted.

opsbot: incident state updated -> mitigating. Mitigations active.

alex: Closing the initial surge page — mitigations in place, monitoring. Timeline note: mitigation applied at 3759990060.

marta: I'll keep dashboard watch for next 45m. If we see retries spike when restoring, we'll re-evaluate per-tenant penalties (token-bucket throttles).

alex: Thanks team. Quick notes for postmortem: root cause — customer retry loops + lack of per-tenant backpressure; mitigation — staged soft-rate, scoped exec suspend, text-only output to reduce payload overhead.

jordan: ack. I'll own the bridge and support comms if any dedicated plan customers escalate.

lina-support: Posting internal note and preparing targeted emails for affected customers once we have final list.

alex: :thumbsup: leaving in handoff state.
